Only when I return to the start room (Home gym) and confirm all unique rooms in my path have been visited will I issue "DONE". Specifically, after leaving the Bathroom the second time, instead of going south back to the Home office, I should have recognized the loop and checked if the Home gym was still unvisited, ensuring I don't stop until the full set is covered.
